statements.sql: UPDATE workspace.docs_rag_dev.silver_chunks SET embed_text = substr(embed_text, 1, length(embed_text) - 1) WHERE config_id = 'ccbd80f05e15c8dd' AND source_repo = 'apache/spark' AND version_tag = 'v3.5.0' AND chunk_id = '8671aa6681209fb927671f5ca820d8fb' AND embed_text LIKE '%!'

SELECT path, chunk_index, n_tokens, length(embed_text) AS len, right(embed_text, 20) AS tail FROM workspace.docs_rag_dev.silver_chunks WHERE config_id = 'ccbd80f05e15c8dd' AND source_repo = 'apache/spark' AND version_tag = 'v3.5.0' AND chunk_id = '8671aa6681209fb927671f5ca820d8fb'
SELECT config_id, version_tag, count(*) AS chunks, count(DISTINCT chunk_id) AS ids FROM workspace.docs_rag_dev.silver_chunks GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
SELECT version, operation FROM (DESCRIBE HISTORY workspace.docs_rag_dev.silver_chunks) ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 3
